main.description: Signaling for voice channels over a WebSocket. Frames are JSON text, each an object tagged with $type. The client sends the social.colibri.beta.voice.defs frames join, leave, getRtpCapabilities, createTransport, connectTransport, produce, closeProducer, consume, resumeConsumer, setConsumerPreference, setSelfState, setSpeaking, heartbeat, rttReport and moveNow. Media flows over WebRTC transports negotiated here.

auth.description: Service auth token with lxm social.colibri.beta.voice.subscribeSignals, for clients that can't set an Authorization header on a WebSocket.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The upgrade request has no valid service auth. Answered with HTTP 401 before the WebSocket opens.
